micro_geofence.role: Analytical AIS corridor segmentation; not a legal or navigational boundary.

principles: Broad API zones are preserved for backward compatibility.
Micro-zones are calculated independently from coordinates.
DISAPPEARED means repeated AIS absence, not proven physical departure.
Confirmed micro transit requires WEST -> CORE -> EAST or reverse.
AIS absence is not evidence of physical vessel absence.
DWT and vessel counts are logistics indicators, not direct physical oil throughput.
